newsitem.title: USA: Key U.S. lawmaker hails Senate electricity bill.
newsitem.headline: Key U.S. lawmaker hails Senate electricity bill.

text.p: U.S. House energy and power subcommittee chairman Dan Schaefer welcomed the introduction Thursday of a bill in the Senate to open the electricity market to competition.

The Colorado Republican, who last year introduced a sweeping electricity restructuring bill and is expected to reoffer it next week, said the bill would help give the debate momentum. The bill was offered earlier Thursday by Democratic Sen. Dale Bumpers of Arkansas.
"This is a good signal to the American people that both houses of Congress are becoming serious about this important consumer issue," Schaefer said in a statement.
Government officials and industry lobbyists expect the House to move more quickly than the Senate on electricity restructuring.
